relevance_note: Cohort mutation study naming individual SSADH-deficient patients with ALDH5A1 variants, e.g. 'the cysteine residue at position 223 that was mutated to a tyrosine in Patient 21'.
method_note: Read by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON, copied the Table 3 row segments from the file, and checked spans and fields. Table 2 (per-family genotypes, ethnic origin, references and patient initials for 54 families) is scrambled by the conversion: family numbers, mutation cells, genotype, origin and reference cells are merged across rows and misaligned (e.g. the row for family 1 carries the Aoshima et al. [2002] reference, which the text and reference list tie to the Japanese patient). No cell of Table 2 could be attributed to a family with confidence, so it was not used for any value; only families/patients the running text names with an individual-level fact got rows (families 3, 4, 19, 29, 47 as 'Table 2 #n'; Patients 7, 21, 25, 34, 42 as labelled in the text), plus the Japanese patient (possibly the same as one Table 2 family; not merged) and the Neu et al. 2002 patient. The other ~44 families of Table 2 got no rows although they are in scope; a re-extraction from the original PDF table would be needed. Table 4 (expression activities) is converted as one row of stacked values and was not read by position (D-31). Variant rows with 'not reported' strings: Table 2 #3 (a nonsense mutation per the Discussion), #4, #19, #47, Patient 34 and the Japanese patient (text says 'two alterations'; one row recorded): the paper ties ALDH5A1 mutations to them but they are only in the unreadable Table 2. Common polymorphisms the authors call non-causal (H180Y c.538C4T, P182L c.545C4T; population frequencies 23% and 7%) were not recorded. G36R (c.106G4C), which the authors call slightly activity-reducing and not detected in controls, was recorded for family 3 and Patient 25; c.1389T4C (silent) was recorded for family 29. Pathogenicity 'Disease-causing' comes from the Table 3 caption for variants listed there. N255S is ambiguous: listed in Table 3 but described as intermediate (17%) and its causal role in Patient 25 is discussed as uncertain. Contradictions/oddities: the Discussion names 'G533K' right after 'G533R' (presumably the same variant); the silent variant is given as c.1389T4C affecting codon D463 while Table 4/text list c.1398C4T (D464D); the text gives both 33 and 35 as the total number of mutations; '4' in variant strings is the converted '>' and is kept as printed. No checklist feature is reported for any individual; all checklist rows are 'not reported'. cohort_size_as_stated = 61 newly screened patients (48 families); six earlier-published families are additionally in Table 2; n_patients_reported left null because no total of variant carriers is stated.
